evidence.source: 李學勤主編《字源》, 2012, 天津古籍出版社／遼寧人民出版社, ISBN 9787552800692
evidence.field: 月部 entry; printed p. 618; PDF p. 631; supplied original scan visually inspected
evidence.text: The 月 entry calls the graph pictographic and says its early form resembles a half moon, representing the moon. It reports occasional confusion with 夕, continuity through bronze forms, and graphic change by small-seal script. It cites the eclipse inscription 《合集》11485, relates calendar-month use to the moon’s waxing and waning, and mentions an extended ‘time’ sense. The scan shows the 月 entry ending before the next headword 朔.
evidence.title: 字源

evidence.source: Taiwan Ministry of Education, Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants
evidence.text: The current dictionary entry gives Mandarin yuè and lists moon, moonlight, ‘each month,’ round-shaped things, a time-counting unit, surname, and radical senses, with examples including 月刊, 月琴, and 月餅. It supports these as dictionary-recorded senses, but does not establish that each is in current everyday use or date their first occurrence.
evidence.title: [A01841] 月 - 教育部《異體字字典》

evidence.source: 漢語多功能字庫, Chinese University of Hong Kong
evidence.field: 漢字甲骨部件分析; 月 entry, lines 128–131
evidence.text: The entry describes oracle-bone and bronze forms as half-moon depictions and identifies ‘moon’ as the original meaning. It reports 《合集》11483正 in an eclipse context and separately gives calendar-month examples from 《合集》5658正 and 曶鼎. It connects the month sense with the moon’s cycle, but those examples do not establish relative chronology. It also reports, attributing the account to 裘錫圭, that 月 and 夕 shared a graph before later graphic specialization.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫：漢字甲骨部件分析

evidence.source: 中央研究院歷史語言研究所, journal article gujinNO35
evidence.field: PDF pp. 6–8; discussion and dating analysis of 《合集》11485
evidence.text: The article transcribes the 《合集》11485 eclipse record as ‘三日乙酉夕月有食’ and analyzes calendrical reconstruction and possible absolute dates. It independently confirms that the 字源 citation number 11485 is printed as supplied; this supports preserving the book’s citation rather than changing it to CUHK’s different cited example, 11483正.
evidence.title: 殷曆月首諸說平議

evidence.source: 中央研究院歷史語言研究所, Chinese Character Database
evidence.field: 字形演變; basic explanation, lines 40–51
evidence.text: The page presents 月 in oracle-bone, bronze, Chu-script and small-seal categories and says its shape resembles a crescent moon, with ‘moon’ as its original meaning. It identifies no smaller semantic or phonetic components.
evidence.title: 漢字「月」：字形演變

evidence.source: Taiwan Ministry of Education, Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants
evidence.text: The entry distinguishes the moon graph from a similar-looking 月-shaped component in characters including 服, 前, 俞, 朕, and 勝, which it identifies as a transformed 舟. This supports caution against assigning 月’s moon meaning to every modern 月-shaped part.
evidence.title: [A01841] 月 - 教育部《異體字字典》

gaps: The exact first dated attestation of 月 is not established. The sources report Shang oracle-bone examples, but this research did not independently establish corpus priority for the graph or earliest use.

The relative chronology of moon and calendar-month uses remains unresolved; both are reported in Shang material, and the book’s explanation via the lunar cycle does not itself date the semantic development.
The MOE dictionary lists moonlight, monthly, round-form, time-unit, and surname senses with examples, but their first attestations and detailed semantic transitions were not established.
The date and mechanism of 月/夕 graphic differentiation are unresolved. CUHK reports the account attributed to 裘錫圭, while the Fudan-hosted discussion could not be opened directly.
Word-family proposals in the dossier involving Proto-Sino-Tibetan, Tibetan ngo, 越, 外, 歲, and the proposed lost-word analysis in 名 were not independently investigated and are not endorsed here.
The upstream official Unihan character record could not be opened; preserve the provided local kMandarin yuè row as local evidence only.

The supplied scan directly confirms the printed citation 《合集》11485. CUHK cites a different eclipse example, 《合集》11483正; the discrepancy is explained by distinct cited examples, not a verified OCR error, so no OCR correction is proposed.
The 字源 scan states that the small-seal form has graphic change (讹变), but the consulted external sources do not resolve the precise transition or mechanism.
